Tokai Teio demonstrated her true strength 
by defeating Mejiro McQueen, who was 
flourishing in the Senior Year.

In light of this result, the Trainer 
decides that her next race will be the 
Japan Cup.

A few days later, Tokai Teio witnessed 
Mejiro McQueen running with ferocious 
intensity and acknowledged her effort. 
Meanwhile—

Full of confidence, she claimed she would 
win no matter how many times they raced. 
However, Symboli Rudolf gave a harsh 
assessment, stating that "it will not 
necessarily end with the same result."

Tokai Teio's challenge heading toward the 
Japan Cup began with an ominous sense of 
turmoil.
